_comment: INTERIM HARDENING — safe to paste RIGHT NOW. Nothing in the app or the
iPhone Shortcuts breaks, because nothing here requires authentication.
- Wholesale deletion. Every write must produce data that still exists,
so a DELETE, a null write, or a `{}` overwrite is rejected. This is the
'someone wipes all my health data' scenario.
- Destroying the frozen pre-profiles backup at /lifestack (now read-only).
- Junk in the shared food bank (shape + range validation).
- Garbage dates / non-numeric values in the health node.
What this does NOT stop — be clear-eyed:
- Reading. Your data stays publicly readable by anyone with the URL,
which is published in the GitHub repo. Only real auth fixes that.
- Overwriting a value with different-but-valid data.
This is a seatbelt, not a lock. Move to firebase-rules.json (which needs
Firebase Auth added to the app) when you can.
